title: OpenAI publishes a preprint that claims to prove that the matrix multiplication exponent (ω) is exactly 9/4, addressing a major open problem in mathematics (alphaXiv)
summary: alphaXiv: OpenAI publishes a preprint that claims to prove that the matrix multiplication exponent (ω) is exactly 9/4, addressing a major open problem in mathematics — Multiplying two $n\times n$ matrices produces $n^2$ output numbers, yet computing each one as a separate dot product costs on the order of $n^3$ operations.
